fact: Bank Al-Maghrib oversees Morocco's payment systems, including the SIMT retail clearing system, under article 10 of law 76-03 and a multilateral oversight convention signed by all infrastructure managers.
A proposed reform of the rules on payment systems and means of payment would broaden the Bank's prerogatives and require its prior approval of any payment, clearing or settlement system.
Bank Al-Maghrib's payments department says the central bank has organised interoperability and framed access to payment infrastructures, per Le Matin's report of the 11th MFC Talks.
Bank Al-Maghrib's 2025 supervision report says it granted three licences to create payment institutions in 2025 and extended a fourth institution's licence.

Switch Al Maghrib says membership of its national card and mobile switch requires a Bank Al-Maghrib licence and Bank Al-Maghrib's opinion on each application, and that its financial security mechanisms are validated by Bank Al-Maghrib.
